entities.summary: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Vijayawada is a diocese located in the city of Vijayawada in the ecclesiastical province of Visakhapatnam in India. Administratively, the diocese encompasses the geographical Krishna district of the state of Andhra Pradesh. The Diocese of Vijayawada has the largest catholic population (359,000) among all the Suffragan dioceses of the Archdiocese of Visakhapatnam.
